stats.Effect: An Orc Dark Mage with superior talent. He was once known as 'the Hope of the Breka Orc tribe,' but he was tricked into plotting against his leader, and exiled. Now, he dreams of the day he will take vengeance on those who betrayed and exiled him. He grows in power, and uses summoning magic learned from the Dark Elves to harness powerful servitors and minions.
